i01.text: Hi! I'm Sofia. And this is my friend Gus.

i03.text: Today we are going to the city center. It's my mom's birthday tomorrow. I need a present.

i06.text: In this story, you will learn how to ask for directions, how to shop, and how to ask for help. Let's go!

a01.text: Okay, Gus. The city is very big. Please stay with me.

a02.text: Yes, yes. I will stay with you.

a03.text: Don't go far. Do you understand?

a04.text: I understand. I'm not a baby. I'm a goose.

a06.text: Oh, look! A flower shop. Mom loves flowers.

a07.text: Wait here, Gus. I'll be back in two minutes.

a11.text: Two for one? Two burgers for one price?

a12.text: I have to see this. Just for one minute...

b01.text: Where is the burger place? It was here... I think.

b02.text: Hmm. This street is different. Where is the flower shop?

b04.text: Okay. Don't panic, Gus. Take your phone. Call Sofia.

b05.text: No, no, no! My phone is dead!

b06.text: I'm lost! I'm a lost goose in a big city!

b07.text: Okay. Calm down. I can ask someone for help.

d01.text: Hmm. This is not a park. This is a shop.

d03.text: Yes, please. Do you sell phone chargers?

d04.text: Sorry, we don't. But we have maps.

d05.text: A map! Perfect. How much is it?

d07.text: I have... three dollars. And a coupon for burgers.

d08.text: Sorry, the coupon doesn't work here.

d11.text: Oh no. My card is at home.

d12.text: Okay... Here's a small map. It's free.

d13.text: Really? Thank you! You are very kind.

d14.text: No problem. Where do you want to go?

d15.text: Green Street. Next to Big Burger.

d16.text: We are here. Green Street is here.

d17.text: You went the wrong way. Turn left at the bank, not right.

d18.text: Left. Of course. I knew that.

d19.text: Excuse me, can I use your phone? I need to call my friend.

d21.text: Hmm... I don't remember her number.

d22.text: I know the burger menu by heart. But not her number.

e02.text: Where is he? I said wait here!

e03.text: The number you are calling is not available.

e04.text: Oh no. His phone is dead. Again.

e05.text: Excuse me, officer! Can you help me, please? I lost my friend.

e06.text: Of course. What does your friend look like?

e07.text: He is tall. He is white. He has a long neck and an orange nose.

e08.text: A long neck and an orange nose?

e09.text: And he's wearing a blue tie.

e10.text: Miss... is your friend a goose?

e12.text: No, no. Where did you see him last?

e13.text: Here. Next to the flower shop. About twenty minutes ago.

e14.text: Hmm. Is there a place he loves?

f01.text: Go straight... turn left at the bank... past the park... Green Street! I did it!

f04.text: Where were you? I was so worried!

f05.text: I'm sorry. I smelled burgers. Then I got lost. Then my phone died.

f07.text: I know. But I learned a lot today. I asked for directions. I went to a shop. I got a free map!

f08.text: You asked for help in English? I'm proud of you.

f09.text: Thank you. Now... two for one?

f10.text: Okay. But this time you stay with me.

p00.text: Now it's practice time! Listen and repeat after me. Ready?

p01.text: Excuse me. Can you help me?

p03.text: How do I get to Green Street?

p04.text: Go straight. Turn left. Turn right.

p08.text: Can I use your phone, please?

p11.text: Quick question! At the bank, Gus turned right. Was that correct? Write your answer in the comments!

o01.text: Great job! Now you can ask for directions, shop, and ask for help in English.

o03.text: Subscribe for the next story! Bye!

g01.text: Excuse me. Sorry to bother you.

r01.text: Yes, dear? Can I help you?

g02.text: I think I'm lost. I'm looking for a flower shop.

r02.text: A flower shop? There are many flower shops in this city. What is the name of the street?

g03.text: I don't know. It's next to a big burger place.

r03.text: Ah! Big Burger! It's on Green Street.

g04.text: Yes! That's it! How do I get there?

r04.text: It's easy. Go straight. Then turn left at the bank.

r05.text: Then go past the park. Green Street is on your right.

g05.text: Go straight... turn left at the bank... past the park... on my right.

r06.text: That's right. It takes about ten minutes.

r07.text: On foot. Or five minutes if you fly.

g07.text: Ha! I'm a goose, but I don't fly. I walk. Thank you so much!

g08.text: Okay. The bank. Turn... left? Or right?
